Batch crawl stream emits both Page and Error events for mixed success/failure URLs

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import batch_crawl_stream, create_engine, CrawlConfig

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(max_concurrent=1)
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    urls = ["https://example.com/success1", "https://example.com/fail", "https://example.com/success2"]
    result = batch_crawl_stream(engine, urls)
    chunks = []
    async for chunk in result:
        chunks.append(chunk)
    print(result.stream.has_page_event)
    print(result.stream.has_error_event)
    print(result.stream.has_complete_event)

asyncio.run(main())
```
